items.t: Garmin and Waze team up to amplify the power of community-driven awareness for cyclists and drivers
items.sum: Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) today announced a first-of-its-kind collaboration with Waze™, the community-driven navigation app used by 200 million drivers around the world. Cyclists using a compatible Garmin Edge® bike computer or Garmin smartwatch can now share their LiveTrack™ locations1 for outdoor cycling activities and it will show up as a real-time alert for drivers using the Waze mobile app.
